title: Fuso Canter 4x4 Powder Coated Alloy Bullbar #14
description: Fuso Canter 4x4 Powder Coated Alloy Bullbar. 76mm pipe with mesh headlight protection, driving light mounts, UHF ariel mount. This bull bar is mounted 200mm forward to give maximum cab protection additional ca/bull bar clearance. Heavy duty backing plate with tow pin. Powder coating colours can be chosen from a wide range of colours.
